name: 1941_kiev
title: Battle of Kiev, Sept 1941
notes: Battle of Kiev (Kesselschlacht bei Kiew), 14-26 Sep 1941 — the INNER POCKET: the 6. Armee's final assault on the city through the Kiev Fortified Region belt (16-19 Sep, entered 'from the north' 19 Sep) while 2./1. Panzergruppen pressed the pocket's E/SE faces (Lokhvitsa 14 Sep, Lubny 13 Sep, Khorol 12 Sep). Rosters researched (en/de/ru Wikipedia: Battle of Kiev (1941), Schlacht um Kiew (1941), Kiev Fortified Region + Oborona Kievskogo UR (1941), 37th/26th Army (ru), XXIX./LI./XVII. AK (de), and every division's own article). ATTACKER (82 bns): 6. Armee city assault — 71. ID (IR 191/194/211, AR 171, Pz.Jg.171, Pi.Btl.171; Gostomel-Irpen-Belogorodka W/NW axis, led the 16 Sep XXIX. AK assault), 296. ID (IR 519/520/521, AR 296; Guta-Meschigorska-Dnieper N/NW sector, Stemmermann), 95. ID (IR 278/279/280, AR 195; assisted the assault, Babi Yar sector); 2. PzGr inner E face — 3. Pz (Pz.Rgt. 6, Schtz.Rgt. 3, Kradschtz.Btl. 3, AR 75, Pz.Jg.39; Lokhvitsa 14 Sep), 4. Pz (Pz.Rgt. 35, Schtz.Rgt. 12, Kradschtz.Btl. 34, AR 103, Pz.Jg.49; Romny counterattack 19 Sep), 10. ID (mot) (IR (mot) 20/41/85, AR 10); 1. PzGr SE face — 16. Pz (Pz.Rgt. 2, Pz.Gren.Rgt. 64/79, Kradschtz.Btl. 16, AR 16, Pz.Jg.16; Khorol 12 Sep, Hube). 1941 equipment: Pz.III 5cm KwK 38 L/42 (Ausf G/H, ~50mm applique front), Pz.IV short 7.5cm L/24, Pz.II (light); truck-towed guns in the mobile divisions, horse-towed in the IDs (1941 IDs had no organic AA — FlaK was corps-level). EXCLUDED (outer ring/second echelon, never at the city): XLVII PzK (17./18. Pz, 29. mot — Sevsk/Trubchevsk), XXXXVIII mot (16./25. mot), III. PzK echelon (13./14. Pz, 60. mot, SS Wiking), XLVI PzK (10. Pz, SS Das Reich — Desna), Inf.Rgt. Großdeutschland + 1. Kav. Div (NE outer), 44./111./299./113./262./98. ID (N/NE sealing on the Desna/Gornostaipol-Borispol axis), 2. Armee IDs (far NW), 17. Armee (southern rim). DEFENDER (63 bns): 37. Armiya (Vlasov) — 147. SD (600./640. SP only — 551. SP destroyed 1 Aug; 379. AP, 231. OATD, the attached 132. TP as T-26 remnants; Vita-Pochtovaya south sector, org 35), 175. SD (560./632./728. SP, 630. AP, 171. OATD; Tarasovka-Yurovka SW, org 35), 206. SD (722./737./748. SP, 661. AP, 35. OATD; Zhulyany counterattacks, org 40), 284. SD (1043./1045./1047. SP, 820. AP, 334. OATD; Pirogovo south, formed 10 Jul — freshest, org 45); Kiev Fortified Region (161./193./28. OPB machine-gun bns + 2. SPB sapper-pontoon bn, def 26; the KUR's own guns ride the fortress: 377./344. GAP + 45./538. iptad — no pure-artillery divisions, P2 ruling); 4. NKVD MSR + 20th border detachment (blocking service, org 35); Kiev People's Militia (19 detachments compressed to 3 bns, org 25); 26. Armiya (Kostenko) SE flank — 97. SD (69./136./233. SP, 41. AP, 87. OATD; Orzhitsa, annihilated 23 Sep, org 40). EXCLUDED: 3rd VDV Corps (5./6./212. AB Bdes left for the Konotop axis 29 Aug — only 5th AB remnants stayed), 295. SD (to 5. Army 7 Sep), 171. SD (east bank from 21 Aug), 87. SD (Korosten, disbanded 19 Sep), 228. SD (NE, <2,000 men), 227. SD (escaped the pocket 5 Sep), 21./5. Army remnants (escaped NE via Priluki-Piryatin), 164. SD (18. Army, never near Kiev), 5th Tank Bde (Sakhno = Naro-Fominsk, Oct 1941 — not Kiev), 4th/10th NKVD Divisions (did not exist in 1941; the 4th is a 1943 formation). dirs=NW,E,SE: the 6. Armee's W/NW assault through the KUR belt, the 2. PzGr inner E face, the 1. PzGr Sula-valley SE face. No player_side field: the script does not prescribe who the player commands — schema default attacker, flip freely in the menu/CLI; enemy_tactic=encirclement is the AI card for the default enemy. Stats = 1941 calibration (Pz.III/IV as medium 25/19/80; Soviet infantry worn to org 35-45).
